task_completion.description: The agent successfully opens the PEBL application or navigates to the correct directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing the path /home/ga/pebl/battery/ or the PEBL Launcher window open.

task_completion.description: The agent selects the 'flanker' task from the list of available experiments.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'flanker' experiment is highlighted or selected in the PEBL Launcher interface.

task_completion.description: The agent enters '101' as the subject number in the prompt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or text field showing the value '101' entered for the subject/participant ID.

task_completion.description: The Flanker task experiment window launches successfully.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A full-screen or windowed graphical interface specific to the Eriksen Flanker Task (usually a dark background with instructions or a fixation cross).

task_completion.description: The agent completes at least 5 practice trials within the experiment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A sequence of screenshots showing at least 5 distinct stimulus presentations (arrows like <<<<< or <<><<) and the agent's corresponding responses, or a progress screen indicating practice trials are being completed.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PEBL GUI rather than just simulating a process exit.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements, button highlights, or text entry visible within the PEBL application windows.

integrity.description: The agent provided actual keyboard/mouse inputs to the stimuli rather than skipping the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual changes in the experiment UI (e.g., stimuli disappearing or feedback appearing) following agent input actions.

integrity.description: The agent used the specified directory for the battery.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path /home/ga/pebl/battery/ is visible during the navigation or execution phase.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Eriksen Flanker Task in PEBL requires the subject ID '101'. The task involves responding to the direction of a central arrow flanked by other arrows. Practice trials occur at the beginning of the session. The PEBL battery is located at /home/ga/pebl/battery/.
